english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the hand tool, including the long-handled kind used to cut grass or grain.

examples.english: The farmer uses a scythe to harvest the rice in the field.
examples.traditional: 農夫用鐮刀收割田入面嘅稻米。
